GARDENA CITY COUNCIL

  Council Chamber at City Hall

  Website: www.cityofgardena.org

  Tuesday, August 13, 2024
  Open Session 7:30 p.m.
TASHA CERDA, Mayor  MINA SEMENZA, City Clerk
RODNEY G. TANAKA, Mayor Pro Tem  GUY H. MATO, City Treasurer
MARK E. HENDERSON, Council Member  CLINT OSORIO, City Manager
PAULETTE C. FRANCIS, Council Member  CARMEN VASQUEZ, City Attorney
WANDA LOVE, Council Member  LISA KRANITZ, Assistant City Attorney

If you would like to participate in this meeting, you can participate via the following
options:
  1. VIEW THE MEETING live on SPECTRUM CHANNEL 22 or ONLINE at
  youtube.com/CityofGardena

  2. PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING by emailing the Deputy City Clerk at
  publiccomment@cityofgardena.org by 5:00p.m. on the day of the meeting and write
  "Public Comment" in the subject line.

  3. ATTEND THE MEETING IN PERSON

  PUBLIC COMMENT: The City Council will hear from the public on any item on the
  agenda or any item of interest that is not on the agenda at the following times:
  Agenda Items – At the time the City Council considers the item or during Oral
  Communications
  Non-agenda Items – During Oral Communications
  Public Hearings – At the time for Public Hearings listed on the Agenda
  If you wish to address the Council, please complete a “Speaker Request” form and
  present it to the City Clerk or Sergeant of Arms. You will be called to the podium by
  name when it is your turn to address the Council. The City Council cannot legally take
  action on any item not scheduled on the Agenda. Such items may be referred for
  administrative action or scheduled on a future Agenda. Members of the public wishing to
  address the City Council will be given three (3) minutes to speak.

  4. The City of Gardena, in complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA),
  requests individuals who require special accommodations to access, attend and/or
  participate in the City meeting due to disability, to please contact the City Clerk's Office
  by phone (310) 217-9565 or email cityclerk@cityofgardena.org at least 24 business
  hours prior to the scheduled general meeting to ensure assistance is provided. Assistive
  listening devices are available.

  1
 STANDARDS OF BEHAVIOR THAT PROMOTE CIVILITY AT ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS

  Treat everyone courteously;
  Listen to others respectfully;
  Exercise self-control;
  Give open-minded consideration to all viewpoints;
  Focus on the issues and avoid personalizing debate; and
  Embrace respectful disagreement and dissent as democratic rights, inherent
  components of an inclusive public process, and tools for forging sound decisions

Thank you for your attendance and cooperation

  Gardena City Council
  Tuesday, August 13, 2024

  The Regular Meeting Notice and Agenda of the Gardena City Council of the City of Gardena,
  California, was called to order at 7:40 PM on Tuesday, August 13, 2024, in the Council
  Chamber at City Hall 1700 West 162nd Street, Gardena, California, Mayor Tasha Cerda
  presiding.

  1.  ROLL CALL

  Present: Mayor Cerda; Mayor Pro Tem Rodney G. Tanaka; Council Member Mark E.
  Henderson; Council Member Paulette C. Francis; and Council Member Wanda Love.
  Other City Officials and Employees present: City Manager Clint Osorio; City Attorney
  Carmen Vasquez; City Clerk Mina Semenza; Treasurer Guy H Mato; and Deputy City
  Clerk Becky Romero.

  PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  2.  CLOSED SESSION - None

  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Sisters Maya and Emma Hironymous, led the Pledge of Allegiance. Maya is in the 3rd Grade
  and attends Amestoy Elementary School. She is the first student of the inaugural Japanese
  Dual Language program at Amestoy Elementary. She is beginning the Conservatory of Fine
  Arts, studying Voice. Emma is in the Gifted Magnet Program at Robert E. Peary Middle
  School and is entering her 3rd year of the Conservatory of Fine Arts, studying World Dance.
  Both Maya and Emma have participated in many City of Gardena events and love the
  Recreation Department.

  4.  INVOCATION

  Reverend Nobuharu Uzunoe of the Konko Church of Gardena led the Invocation.

  5.  PRESENTATIONS

  5.A  Recognition of the City of Gardena Police Department Canine Officers for being
  awarded 1st Place at the Los Angeles County Police Canine Association - 23rd
  Annual Police K9 Demonstration – Police Chief Mike Saffell and Lieutenant
  Christopher Cuff spoke about both K9’s, Maxo and Vito, and their
  accomplishments at the demonstration. Two videos were shown
  demonstrating the canine officers’ performances and a certificate was
  presented by Police Chief Mike Saffell and accepted by Canine Officers
  Humberto Ruvalcaba and Mike Medeiros.

  5.B  Gardena Events Video Presentation

  22. COUNCIL REMARKS

  (1) COUNCIL MEMBER HENDERSON – Since the last meeting, he was honored to do the
  greeting at the Citizens Leadership Academy, so for those that are missing out this is
  there third class of the Citizens Leadership Academy it is an opportunity for our
  community to get well versed in what we do in this community as far as our city
  departments and everything. He attended some business meetings and some
  community meetings. He participated in an informal meeting with LA county in regard to
  sustainability. He participated in the seminar in regard to further use of AI in government,
  so he is going to challenge our staff to start looking into that. He attended the Quake
  Hero Expo this past Saturday and watched the film in regard to the Northridge
  Earthquake that happened in 1995. He also attended our Employee Mixer; from the
  bottom of his heart, he wants to thank our staff, thank the City Manager in regard to the
  responsiveness and acumen of the staff that we have here in Gardena City Council.
  Every time he talks to somebody at a different function, he shares the knowledge that
  they share with me, with other colleagues and in other communities. They say where’d
  you learning about that his response is “I just talk to staff”. He definitely encourages folks
  if they have a question, just submit your question, someone will get back to you. He
  wants the staff to know that they have support from him Council Member Henderson in
  regards to what you do and continue to do what you do and make us all smarter up here.
  He also participated in an International Conference with some folks across the pond over
  in England, in regards to the Independent Cities Association and kind of what we do as
  40 cities in the county and they wanted to know what his vision was going to be for our
  40 cities moving forward; he told them he’s developing that vision a little more he’s going
  to talk to his eboard this week and they’re going to figure out what they need to do. He
  gave a preliminary understanding that his tenure this time is going to be more about
  inclusion, diversity, and equity for all our LA County cities to make sure everybody’s
  voices are heard equally.

  (2) MAYOR PRO TEM TANAKA – Since our last meeting, he went on to say that Council
  Member Henderson made a great presentation about our Employee Quarterly Mixer. It’s
  a really great event because all of our directors and their departments get together and
  have a great time interacting with other departments. Plus, we showcase our new
  employees and those that have been promoted within that time frame, so it really does

  (3) COUNCIL MEMBER LOVE– Since our last meeting, she attended the City’s Candlelight

  a lot of the residents come out and dance to the country music; she attended the MLK

  the largest in the South Bay. She attended Holly Mitchell’s School supply giveaway,
  where she gave away laptops, iPads, and lots and lots of resources, and backpacks.
  She also attended Steve Bradford’s School supply giveaway over at Compton College
  this past weekend.

  (4) MAYOR CERDA – Since the last council meeting, she attended the Citizen Leadership
  Academy and for those residents who are watching this meeting now if you want to learn
  more about Gardena this is a great way to do it. If you’d like to know more about city
  government and how things work, consider signing up for the next class starting. We
  have a great group of directors that love explaining about all the departments. She had
  the pleasure of hearing about Public Works, she thought she knew everything but her
  colleague and herself learned some things the other day about Public Works. It’s just a
  great way for the community to come out and get informed, know the process, relating
